Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act serves as the legal basis for the government to exercise powers regarding duty and tax exemptions or modifications.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legislative authority for the government to implement changes in tax-related notifications.
National Board of Revenue: The government is required to consult with this body before issuing or amending specific customs notifications in the public interest.
S.R.O. 203-AIN/2015: This existing notification is formally amended to update the list of goods and their associated codes mentioned in its table.
TABLE: The table of the specified notification is amended by replacing existing entries under Heading 29.33 with a new list of pharmaceutical chemicals and active ingredients.
A new Heading 29.35 is inserted into the table containing the chemical entry for Baricitinib.
